problems: The blind guess (heron or crane, long neck, outstretched wings) is loosely compatible: there is a head at the top, a vertical neck/body, and wings spread out. But the figure does not read clearly as a gull. It has no filled body, only a thin wobbly line from the crown down to the tail, so it looks more like a stick or a bow.

The blue outline is a loopy, self-crossing path, especially near the tail root (around 255-290, 318-335) and along the neck. It reads as a tangle, not a clean silhouette, and it closely shadows the gold lines, so it looks like a traced copy of them.

Labels collide badly: 'breast, the centre of the body' runs over the 'right wing trailing edge' label and its star, 'left wing root, on the trailing edge' overlaps the wing line, and 'root of the tail' and 'outer tail feather tip (Kassu' crowd the tail stars. Several parts cannot be identified by label.

Star placement is roughly right: crown (249,165), left wingtip (104,191), left wrist (147,245), right wrist (306,205), right wingtip (358,233), tail root (282,323) and tail tip (336,327) sit where expected. The breast and right-trailing-edge stars (about 262-320, 265-270) are close together and hard to tell apart.
The figure is small and sits high-left of centre in a large empty frame, and the stray stars at (125,358) and (84,414) are unlabelled and add noise.
Orientation is correct: the head is at the top and the tail at the bottom.
output.advice:
Redraw as a filled, solid bird silhouette in a gull pose, with the wings raised and spread, rather than a wireframe. Keep the stars on the same parts and make the outline follow them without self-crossing.

- Head: round the crown star 78554 (~249,165) into a small head, and let the neck run down from it.
- Body: fill a teardrop body from the breast star 78481 (~262,265) down to the tail root 78072 (~282,323). The body should be the widest part, around the breast, not a single line.
- Left wing: draw a broad wing from the body shoulder through the left wing root 79043 (~219,293), out to the left wrist 80170 (~147,245), then to the left wingtip 80816 (~104,191). Trace the trailing edge back along the underside to the body.
- Right wing: from the body shoulder, go up to the right wrist 77661 (~306,205), out to the right wingtip 76852 (~358,233), then back along the trailing edge through 77450 (~320,268) to the body.
- Tail: fan out from the tail root 78072 to the outer tail feather tip 77233 (~336,327), keeping it on the right side.
- Move or shorten the labels so 'breast' and 'right wing trailing edge' do not overlap, and offset the 'root of the tail' and 'Kassu' labels away from the tail stars. Delete or label the unlabelled stars at (125,358) and (84,414).
- Enlarge the figure so it fills more of the frame, and keep the head at the top."]
